candidate.answerReason: Dividing by \(-3\) reverses the inequality to \(x\ge-4\). The included integer endpoint \(-4\) is the smallest solution.

methods.label: Solve and use the included endpoint
methods.explanation: Dividing both sides by \(-3\) reverses the inequality sign, giving \(x\ge-4\), so the smallest integer is \(-4\).
methods.levelReason: Solving by negative division and selecting an included integer endpoint use Grade 7 inequality properties and numerical order.
